name: Section-30
css:
<style>
        .section-30 {
            width: 100%;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 28px 20px 26px;
            background: #fff;
            font-family: sans-serif;
            color: #0c2b6e;
            box-shadow: 0 18px 48px var(--cor-geral-sombra);
            border-radius: 24px;
            box-sizing: border-box
        }

        .section-30 *,
        .section-30 *::before,
        .section-30 *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box
        }

        .section-30__viewport {
            width: 100%;
            margin: 0 auto;
            overflow: hidden
        }

        .section-30__track {
            display: flex;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            list-style: none;
            transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
        }

        .section-30__item {
            flex: 0 0 100%;
            min-width: 0;
            padding: 6px
        }

        .section-30__card {
            position: relative;
            height: 100%;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 16px 14px 18px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid #eadde2;
            border-radius: 16px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: transform .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease
        }

        .section-30__card::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 0 0 999px 999px;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scaleX(.45);
            transition: opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease
        }

        .section-30__card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            border-color: #d4b7c0;
            box-shadow: 0 16px 35px rgba(7, 29, 62, 0.09)
        }

        .section-30__card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scaleX(1)
        }

        .section-30__media-wrap {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 108px;
            height: 108px;
            margin: 0 auto 14px
        }

        .section-30__media-wrap::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 4px;
            border-radius: 26px;
            transform: rotate(5deg);
            transition: transform .4s ease
        }

        .section-30__card:hover .section-30__media-wrap::before {
            transform: rotate(0)
        }

        .section-30__media {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 98px;
            height: 98px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 23px;
        }

        .section-30__image {
            display: block;
            width: 95%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: contain;
            object-position: center;
            transition: transform .45s ease
        }

        .section-30__card:hover .section-30__image {
            transform: scale(1.05)
        }

        .section-30__card-title {
            margin: 0 0 7px;
            color: #0a255e;
            font-size: .94rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.25
        }

        .section-30__card-text {
            max-width: 230px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            color: #785563;
            font-size: .8rem;
            line-height: 1.45
        }

        .section-30__controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 9px;
            max-width: 1180px;
            margin: 16px auto 0
        }

        .section-30__button {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid #dec8cf;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: #fff;
            color: #0c2b6e;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: .78rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            transition: transform .25s ease, background-color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease
        }

        .section-30__button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            border-color: #7675a8;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(7, 33, 62, 0.09)
        }

        .section-30__control {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 2;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            margin: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            cursor: pointer
        }

        .section-30__button-number {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            pointer-events: none
        }

        .section-30__button:has(.section-30__control:checked) {
            border-color: #0e0c6e;
            background: #0e0c6e;
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 7px 16px rgba(12, 66, 110, 0.18)
        }

        .section-30__button:has(.section-30__control:focus-visible) {
            outline: 3px solid rgba(255, 153, 0, .35);
            outline-offset: 3px
        }

        .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-1:checked) .section-30__track {
            transform: translateX(0)
        }

        .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-2:checked) .section-30__track {
            transform: translateX(-100%)
        }

        .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-3:checked) .section-30__track {
            transform: translateX(-200%)
        }

        .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-4:checked) .section-30__track {
            transform: translateX(-300%)
        }

        .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-5:checked) .section-30__track {
            transform: translateX(-400%)
        }

        @media(min-width:768px) {
            .section-30 {
                padding: 18px 24px
            }

            .section-30__item {
                flex-basis: 50%;
                padding: 7px
            }

            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-1:checked) .section-30__track {
                transform: translateX(0)
            }

            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-2:checked) .section-30__track {
                transform: translateX(-50%)
            }

            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-3:checked) .section-30__track {
                transform: translateX(-100%)
            }

            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-4:checked) .section-30__track,
            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-5:checked) .section-30__track {
                transform: translateX(-150%)
            }

            .section-30__button--5 {
                display: none
            }
        }

        @media(min-width:1200px) {
            .section-30 {
                padding: 18px 24px
            }

            .section-30__viewport {
                overflow: visible
            }

            .section-30__item {
                flex-basis: 20%;
                padding: 7px
            }

            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-1:checked) .section-30__track,
            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-2:checked) .section-30__track,
            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-3:checked) .section-30__track,
            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-4:checked) .section-30__track,
            .section-30:has(#section-30-slide-5:checked) .section-30__track {
                transform: none
            }

            .section-30__controls {
                display: none
            }
        }

        @media(max-width:575px) {
            .section-30 {
                padding: 18px 14px
            }

            .section-30__card {
                padding: 16px 14px 18px
            }

            .section-30__media-wrap {
                width: 104px;
                height: 104px
            }

            .section-30__media {
                width: 94px;
                height: 94px
            }
        }

        @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {

            .section-30__track,
            .section-30__card,
            .section-30__image,
            .section-30__media-wrap::before,
            .section-30__button {
                transition: none
            }
        }
    </style>
